steps.displayName: Generate Video Script and Search Terms
steps.instruction: You are a short-form video script writer. Use the input to write a complete spoken script for the requested duration and provide 5–10 short English keywords for searching stock footage. Use a different angle for each candidate index. Output only one valid JSON object in this exact shape: {"script":"complete script","videoTerms":["keyword one","keyword two"]}. Do not include Markdown, code fences, explanations, or any text outside the JSON. Both script and videoTerms must be non-empty.

instructions: Generate one independent script candidate for each row.
Use candidateIndex to give candidates for the same topic distinct angles.
